title: Verihogg SystemVerilog Formatter Configuration
description: Configuration for the Verihogg SystemVerilog formatter.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this configuration schema, for editor tooling.

indentation_spaces.description: Number of spaces per indentation level.

line_terminator.description: Line ending used by the formatter.

line_break_penalty.description: Penalty for introducing an additional line break during layout optimization.

over_column_limit_penalty.description: Penalty for exceeding the configured column limit.

port_declarations_alignment.description: Alignment of port direction, type, dimensions and name.

module_net_variable_alignment.description: Alignment of net and variable declarations inside blocks.

formal_parameters_alignment.description: Alignment of formal parameters in module, interface and class headers.

named_parameter_alignment.description: Alignment of named parameters in instantiations.

parameter_declaration_alignment.description: Alignment of parameter and localparam declarations in block bodies.

enum_assignment_statement_alignment.description: Alignment of enum elements with assignments.

struct_union_members_alignment.description: Alignment of struct and union members.

port_declarations_indentation.description: Indentation of ports in a module or interface header.

formal_parameters_indentation.description: Indentation of formal parameters in a header.

named_parameter_indentation.description: Indentation of named parameters in an instantiation.

named_port_indentation.description: Indentation of named ports in an instantiation.

alignment_group_boundary.description: Rule determining where an alignment group ends.

port_declarations_right_align_packed_dim.description: Right-align packed dimensions in port declarations.

port_declarations_right_align_unpacked_d.description: Right-align unpacked dimensions in port declarations.

compact_indexing_and_selections.description: Use compact expressions inside indexes and selections.

class_parameter_space.description: Insert a space before # in parameterized class typedefs.

try_wrap_long_lines.description: Allow optimization-based wrapping of long lines.

wrap_end_else_clauses.description: Place end and else clauses on separate lines.
